Furthermore, control center can be set up anywhere with Internet access without being restricted by monitored site locations

articleTitle: An Improvement for Local Route Repair in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
abstract: In mobile ad hoc networks, a multihop route breaks mainly because of the failure of a link or adjacent links caused by relative movement of one or more nodes, or malfunction and power depletion of one node. When this happens, route repair is typically performed to establish a new route. Such route repair mechanism causes high control overhead and long packet delay. In this paper, a new idea on local route repair (LRR) mechanism that the repair is confined to the vicinity of the broken link is proposed to decrease the reaction time of recovery and the overhead of route maintenance. Simulation results show that our LRR strategy leads to significant performance improvement

articleTitle: An improved Genetic Algorithm Assisted Beamforming for Random Interference Nulling
abstract: This paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm (GA) assisted beamforming for a one-dimensional linear antenna array. Its performance of random interference nulling is studied. We design an improved binary code method for GA, which introduces several parameters to conveniently control the solution precision and search space. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm can efficiently gives a better adaptive suppression against the random interference, and has better convergence than the standardized GA

articleTitle: ITS Technology and Policy in China
abstract: This paper will provide a look back and a look forward of the ITS program in the China. The paper will describe research activities, standardization programs and actual deployment experiences from across the country. In addition a special focus will be presented as the national ITS projects serve the Olympic Games, World Expo, and Asia Games respectively

articleTitle: Server-Aided Public Key Generation Protocols on Low-power Devices for Ad-hoc Networks
abstract: Against the problems emerged in protocols presented by N. Modadugu, D.Boneh and M. Kim (2000), new server-aided public key generation protocols on low-power devices are proposed in this paper. The protocols are secure against some passive attacks, such as "collusion attack" and "the third party attack". In addition, efficiency of primality test on low-power devices is improved in this paper. Prospective applications of the protocols would be found in mobile e-commence, mobile ad-hoc, and military communications

articleTitle: Study on the properties of circular monopole antenna
abstract: Wide band and miniaturization are both the hottest issues in the current researches on antennas. The circular monopole antenna is a kind of ultra-wideband antennas with simple feeding network. Detailed analyses are conducted to determinate the antenna's properties. The design method of the antenna is presented, and the influences on its impedance and radiation properties by varying the dimension parameters of the antenna are discussed. Through simulations and experiments, it is demonstrated that the antenna has a more than 10 times octave impedance bandwidth, good consistency of the horizon directivity diagram and the constant group delay. The results show that the circular monopole antenna has not only the ultra-wideband in frequency domain, but also the stable phase center, which makes the antenna suitable for the antennas in the time domain communication systems. Also, the antenna can easily cover the frequency range from 400 MHz to 4 GHz, which includes the usual bandwidth for RF devices such as RFID devices, GPS receivers, image transmission devices (all these RF devices are applied to various traffic control systems), so that the circular monopole antenna can be used as the antenna for the entire traffic control systems, which greatly reduces the complexity of the whole system

articleTitle: Combined Turbo-TCM and Differential Unitary Space-Time Modulation
abstract: Differential unitary space-time modulation (DUSTM) is well established for high data rate communications in the multi-antennas channel without channel state information (CSI). To achieve the channel capacity, a new scheme, which employs the turbo-trellis coded modulation (TTCM) and DUSTM, is proposed in this paper. Simulation results reveal that in the TTCM-DUSTM scheme, around 12 dB coding gain is obtained over the original DUSTM system at the bit error rate (BER) of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>

articleTitle: A Velocity Measuring System for Vehicle with Camera
abstract: The velocity measuring system includes two classes, radar and lidar. However, these systems usually detect single vehicle. Many cities road, a lot of cameras have been set. They often use to watch vehicles' peccancy, but they can't measure vehicles velocity. In this paper, we introduce a new velocity measuring system with camera. It can measure vehicles velocity by itself. If we upgrade cameras set on road according to this paper method, we can improve city traffic condition on less expense

articleTitle: Gaze Estimation of Human Eye
abstract: As an indispensable component of intelligent transportation systems, the driving assistant has attracted much attention of scholars and engineers. The gaze estimation of human eye just serves for the driving assistant. In this paper the eye and gaze models are introduced first and then improved by us, so that the new models are presented. Based on the new models the Hough transform method with gradient direction is used to perform the iris detection and gaze estimation. In experiments the two parameters of false estimation rate and average detection time are investigated. To the good-quality frame images the false estimation rate is 5.87% and the average detection time is 94.3 milliseconds. In the end the proposed gaze estimation algorithm is applied to a real-time gaze tracking system and the comparison result shows that it has the more accuracy

articleTitle: Integrated Traffic Management Platform Design Based on GIS-T
abstract: The aim of this paper is to describe an integrated traffic management platform using geographical information system on transportation (GIS-T). Existing platforms are almost specially designed for particular traffic control systems, which could not satisfy the increasing demand on traffic facility management, traffic information distribution, and coordinated control among multi control systems. In this paper, three basic design principles of integrated traffic management platform are analyzed: (a) a single database that contains traffic flow data from multi control systems, urban spatial data from GIS, and traffic facility information; (b) GIS-T is the basic application and development software, also real-time traffic flow data and static attribute data are added on urban fundamental geographical data; (c) both urban traffic integrated management and traffic real-time control are on the same platform. Finally, a prototype platform is introduced, and principles are well embodied in the prototype according to the actual traffic situation of Beijing

articleTitle: Concept of vehicle autonomous localisation for railway application
abstract: The presented paper shows an innovative approach to a vehicle autonomous localisation system for railways, providing cost-efficient position information for various safety- or non-safety-related systems especially for protection systems on non-equipped secondary lines. This is the main focus of a project called "DemoOrt" which consists of developing a platform with an onboard, autonomous and vehicle-autarkic technology, a reference measuring platform and safety analysis methodology. This approach integrates and uses available as well as innovative technologies with the main focus on satellite based positioning (GPS, GALILEO and EGNOS)

articleTitle: Adaptive Channel Equalizer for Wireless Access in Vehicular Environments
abstract: Dedicated short range communication (DSRC) is the key component in intelligent transportation systems (ITS). The goal of this technology is to help driver and passengers getting multimedia services via wireless communication equipment during the movement of vehicle, so as to improve the traffic safety and enhance the transportation efficiency. The paper is focus on the DSRC baseband technical analysis and the application development. Based on the WLAN 802.11a architecture, we develop a new adaptive channel estimation algorithm that uses decoder and decision feedback to enhance wireless access ability in vehicular environments

articleTitle: A Method to Enhance the Accuracy of Location Systems Based on TOA-Location Algorithms
abstract: This paper proposes an effective and simple method to enhance the accuracy of location algorithm based on time-of-arrival (TOA) estimates between the source and the receivers. Mathematical Statistics and Geometry theories are applied to the proposed method. The enhanced TOA location algorithms with the proposed method can lower the measurement time or avoid complex iterated algorithm (e.g., Taylor-Series estimation). That is, measurement time and computation complexity can be significantly reduced. Simulation results show that the accuracy of the location estimation can be enhanced by about 15 percent in line-of-sight (LOS) propagation and about 20 percent in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation at best.

articleTitle: Extraction of Gait Features Using a Wireless Body Sensor Network (BSN)
abstract: A body sensor network (BSN) is presented in this paper, which targets at integrating physical activity signal and physiologically related features to provide detailed body context information. Issues concerning the structure of the proposed BSN, functions and interactions between its components are stressed. The BSN has been applied to conduct gait analysis in this study. A gait tracker based on Kalman filter is proposed to estimate hip angle and swing velocity of the lower limb segment using the sensor measurments. Experimental result shows that the movement of the legs during gait cycles is well revealed with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Rate-Compatible LDPC Codes for Cross-Layer Design Combining of AMC with HARQ
abstract: This paper proposes a cross-layer design combining of adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) with hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) based on rate-compatible low-density parity-check codes (RC-LDPC). First we investigate the puncturing pattern of RC-LDPC codes and prove that our puncturing pattern is as good as random puncturing. Then we apply RC-LDPC codes to cross-layer design combing AMC with ARQ over Nakagami-m fading channel and investigate the throughput of the system. Computer simulations show that the joint design of AMC and ARQ base on RC-LDPC codes can achieve considerable spectral efficiency gain

articleTitle: 60GHz Narrow Bandpass Filter Based on Circle Patch and LTCC
abstract: In this paper, a narrow band band pass filter based on LTCC process is designed to satisfy 60 GHz high data rate wireless communication. In this design, circle patch is used to create a 60 GHz resonant frequency instead of ring. Simulation shows that our design is narrow band-pass in the 60 GHz bandwidth and wide band-stop in the low and high frequency

articleTitle: Scalable Video Coding for Subway Platform Monitoring System
abstract: In this paper, we propose a stereoscopic video coding scheme for subway accident monitoring system. The proposed scheme is designed for providing flexible video service among various display environments, such as displays of total traffic control, station employees and train driver. The proposed scheme uses enhanced compatible coding scheme for predicting P- and B-types of pictures in the right-view sequence. It predicts matching block by interpolating both motion and disparity predicted macro-blocks. To provide flexible stereo video service, we define both temporally and spatially scalable layers for each eyes-view by using the concept of spatio-temporal scalability. The experimental results show the efficiency of proposed coding scheme by comparison with already known methods and the advantages of disparity estimation in terms of scalability overhead

articleTitle: Research on Scattering Property of Finite Dipole Array
abstract: Due to the increasing interest on scattering cross section and stealth technology of array antenna recently, the scattering property of finite dipole array is discussed in this paper. RWG basis function is introduced to compute surface current distribution and scattered field. In the dipole model the surface current distribution for each RWG edge element is replaced by an infinitesimal dipole's current, having an equivalent dipole moment. The total scattered field is then obtained as a sum of all these contributions of infinitesimal dipoles. Finally, different space selection among array elements, different incident frequency, different incident angle and different array size are discussed to get their effect on the scattered field

articleTitle: The Interval Modulation System For The Ultra-Wideband Vehicular Radar
abstract: Since the (FCC) Federal Communications Commission approved the (UWB) Ultra-wideband application into the civilian areas, research on the UWB vehicular radar aroused much interest. Using of vehicular sensing radar is an important method in preventing the occurrence of traffic accidents, and enhance the radar's performance can directly improve the effectiveness of the collision prevention system. Ultra-wideband is a relatively new technology adopted in ITS, it can make radar higher resolution, lower power, more immunity to interference and so on. In the UWB radar system, narrow pulse string is the fundamental source of all sensing and detecting information. The narrow pulses string is transmitted to the space under specific order, and the interval modulation circuit establishes this order and triggered the pulse generator radiate according to the specific sequence. The paper introduces the basic concept and the character of the UWB vehicular radar, presents the interval modulation's function in the system, and describes the proposed system in detail. Compared with traditional methods based on analog modules, the proposed system uses almost all digital circuit to achieve the modulating. Measured results of the prototype circuit are presented near the end of the article. Finally the core elements of interval modulation design in the UWB vehicular radar have been analyzed, the section need to be improved and the future trends have been discussed

articleTitle: Type II Hybrid-ARQ Schemes of LDPC Codes Based on Information-Nulling Rate-Compatible Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, information nulling (IN) type II HARQ protocol with low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes is presented. Incremental redundancy is created from partial null versions of the original information data using the same encoder/decoder structure. In comparison to the conventional rate-compatible type II HARQ schemes, the decoder architecture always operates at the highest code rate, thus efficiently exploiting the decoder hardware. The performance analysis shows that the proportion of un-nulled information-bits influences the performance significantly, and the performance of the IN-HARQ system does not increase monotonically as the proportion increases. An improved IN-HARQ scheme is designed with variable proportion values of different retransmission, and some preliminary results have been derived to make sure the optimum proportion of un-nulled information-bits. Another IN-HARQ scheme is presented by combining interleaving and IN-HARQ protocol, which provides additional performance gain of interleaving to the original IN-HARQ scheme

articleTitle: A Roadside Downlink Wireless Transmission Scheme Using OFDM and Virtual MIMO
abstract: In this paper, a downlink wireless transmission scheme is proposed for roadside deployment. The scheme is based on orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) technology, and it also employs virtual multiple input multiple output (MIMO) to further improve system capacity. In the "virtual" MIMO scheme proposed in this paper, signals can be sent from two base stations (BS) to one user, which creates a virtual MIMO system that may offer additional capacity gains in fading channels. This scheme is especially fit for the bi-sectional BSs with zonal coverage along roadside. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can support both high and low speed users on road, and achieve a high system capacity gain especially in the cell edge. Within this scheme, the OFDM symbols are characterized into two groups: localized resource group (LRG), which is continuous in time-frequency (TF) domain; and distributed resource group (DRG) which is TF discrete. As LRG is fit for low-speed users to utilize the slowly varying channel while DRG is fit for high-speed users with rapid varying channels, the combination of them makes the allocation of OFDM subchannel more elastic to support users with different speed

articleTitle: A Model of Intelligent Transport System in Crossroads Based on the Control of Information State Vector of Object Element (CISV)
abstract: According to the principle of electric current, this paper brings forward the conception of microcosmic control and analyzes the model of object elements which abstract from motor vehicles. Based on it, the information state vector of object element is defined. A series of parameters and formulas are given in order to describe the information state of the object element and deduce the differential equations of control. Finally, the pane figure of the system is drawn and a model of intelligent transport system in crossroads is established to replace the signal lamps control system

articleTitle: Integrated Transportation GIS for the City of Guangzhou, China
abstract: This paper challenges existing transportation GIS applications and research perspectives and proposes a preliminary framework for an integrated GIS for the city of Guangzhou. This paper analyzes current conditions, needs and problems faced by the citizens and transportation agencies of Guangzhou. Nowadays, the state of traffic/transportation infrastructures of Guangzhou requires new approaches for the management and planning of urban traffic flows. Taking into account existing applications, demands and problems, the purpose of our research is to provide an integrated multimodal GIS for Intelligent Transportation System.

articleTitle: Semi-blind Channel Estimation and Decoding for Space-Time Block coded System
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of semi-blind channel estimation and decoding for space-time coded system over time-varying fading channel. We derive a state-space model that characterizes the space-time coded system. The channel estimation is performed using a kalman filtering method which operates in two modes: training mode and blind mode. Box-constrained ML algorithm is used to perform the decoding function under the previous state-space system model. The performance of channel estimation and decoding schemes are investigated by computer simulations

articleTitle: Selection of the Filtering Correction Cycle to Improve INS/GPS Integrated Navigation Accuracy
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of INS/GPS integrated navigation system, especially in such a case when it works from the integrated navigation into the pure inertial navigation, the schemes of the Kalman filter correction cycle is proposed. Based on detail analysis on the error rule of INS and the error feature of the GPS output signal from several flight-test data, a reasonable correction cycle is selected. In the end, many flight-test data validate the scheme, and the result show it can make pure inertial system reach further high accuracy

articleTitle: Improved Detection Algorithm Based on Interference Cancellation in MIMO systems
abstract: In this paper, a detection algorithm is proposed for the spatial multiplexing multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system by taking advantages of both the sequential interference cancellation (SIC) and parallel interference cancellation (PIC). It detects layers in the order of ascending SNR of each layer, and then subtracts interference regenerated by the rough estimate from a hard decision based on some criteria, such as minimum mean square error (MMSE) or zero forcing (ZF). However, the improved estimate of the prior detected layers after interference cancellation (IC) will replace their rough estimate to implement IC for the posterior detected layers. Adding SIC into PIC in a proper order can minimize the error propagation (EP) among layers. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm improves the performance over PIC significantly with a little increment of complexity and delay. Otherwise, it does not perform as well as the classical ordered SIC (OSIC), but it reduces the complexity and delay greatly. Thus, the proposed algorithm can achieve a good trade-off between performance and complexity and it is feasible for practical application

articleTitle: Enhancement and implementation of a localization and communication system dedicated to guided transports
abstract: Nowadays, in maritime and airway domains, many intelligent systems are used for the localization and to exchange data information. However, in guided transports domain, no system is able to ensure these two functionalities. This paper presents a new system called CODIBT (Communication, Detection and Identification of broken-down trains) allowing multi-user access and combining the two main functionalities: localization and high data flow rate communication. Such systems are developed in order to improve exploitation inside guided transport networks. Our laboratories designed an original radar system that allows inter-vehicle communication. This system is based on the principle of a co-operative radar using a transponder inside targets. It is made of a couple of transmitter/receiver which equips respectively the front and the rear of two successive vehicles. It uses a numerical correlation receiver and has a broad band of about 100MHz which could be exploited to establish high data flow rate communications. The aim of this paper is to describe the mock-up realized and present some improvements of the coding methods developed using spreading spectrum techniques. Some simulations aimed to evaluate system performance in terms of BER together with main experimental results will be reported.

articleTitle: Fractionally-spaced Space Frequency Equalization in a MIMO-CDMA System
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel fractionally-spaced space frequency equalization (FSSFE) scheme for a single carrier MIMO-CDMA system over frequency selective channels. Simulation results show that our proposed scheme significantly outperforms the conventional frequency domain equalization algorithms while with low complexity. We also provide performance and complexity analysis for the proposed FSSFE

articleTitle: Decision of Cooperative Airfight and its Realization by Neural Network
abstract: For multi-target attacking decision, the airfight preponderant-function has been set up based on experience. Rules of target allotment in multi-target attack have been put forward, then the arithmetic of target assignment in multi-target attack is established, by which the decision of target distribution in cooperative multi-target attacking condition can been given. The artificial neural net was applied to the establishment of preponderant-function and target assignment arithmetic. Simulation experimentations have been made and the result shows that the construction of the ANN is correct

articleTitle: Sub-carriers allocation schemes between cells based on fairness with heavy load in OFDMA based systems
abstract: The channel allocation between cells is a key technique in mobile communication systems and become the hot spot in recent researches. In this paper, we propose two channel allocation schemes between cells based on "fairness" principle, "proportional fairness algorithm" and "proportional fairness algorithm based on greedy", for OFDMA based distributed antenna system in heavy load. The simulation results show the performance of "proportional fairness algorithm based on greedy" is better than the "proportional fairness algorithm", and the former is more suitable to the circumstance of the practical mobile networks

articleTitle: Research on A Carrier Synchronization Method for Digital Radio Compass
abstract: Radio compass called automatic direction finder (ADF) is basic navigation equipment. The traditional radio compasses were implemented with analog circuit, which suffered low precision. The development of software radio technology and DSP technology has made the software radio compass (SRC) possible. The existed SRC needs to convert three input signals to a fixed frequency at the same time and it's hard to synchronize. In this paper, a new method to implement the carrier synchronization is presented and simulated. The simulation results shown the proposed approach can meet the specified radio compass performance

articleTitle: A Novel Pairwise Keys Pre-distribution Scheme Based on Binary Tree in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are wireless networks that include sensor nodes with limited storage and communication capabilities. Security in sensor networks is critical when there are potential adversaries. In this paper we propose a new key pre-distribution scheme which improves the resiliency and wisely uses the different network and the node resources. This scheme uses binary tree and matrix of knowledge which provide selective security levels and enhances networks resilience against node capture without using more memory

articleTitle: Design and Implement of Urban Traffic Management GIS: The Wuhan Case
abstract: GIS-T is an effective means to enhance urban traffic management and relieve urban traffic pressure. According to the practice of Wuhan urban traffic management GIS (WHUTMGIS), this paper detailed explores and outlines the design and implement of the system

articleTitle: Sphere Decoding for Distributed Antenna Systems
abstract: Distributed antenna system (DAS) is one of the promising techniques for next generation wireless communication. In this paper, we firstly present a relatively efficient sphere decoding algorithm (SDA) that performs exact maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding for distributed antenna systems, which does not necessarily require that the number of receive antennas should be no less than that of transmit antennas. Some simulation results in frequency selective fading channel show that bit error rate (BER) performance is influenced by the difference of channel propagation time delays from neighboring transmit antennas to the receive antenna. The increase of difference can result in BER performance improvement

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of a High Mobility Vehicular Communications System Using Fuzzy-Decision Viterbi Decoder
abstract: A fuzzy-decision Viterbi decoder is proposed for a dedicated short-range communications (DSRC) system to combat the effect of a time-varying fading channel. The performance of the DSRC system using the proposed fuzzy-decision Viterbi decoder is compared with both the hard-decision and soft-decision Viterbi decoder. The simulation results show that the gain in performance of the proposed fuzzy-decision Viterbi decoder with respect to the hard-decision and soft-decision Viterbi decoder is significantly increased

articleTitle: The Communications Research in Traffic Control System
abstract: Intelligent traffic control system is an important part of intelligent transportation system. Now, there are several traffic control systems in a city. Because the different systems use their own exclusive protocols, there has the problem of different types of products incompatibility. So to help information exchange among different systems and products, it is necessary to do research to the communications standard of traffic control system. Traffic signal control markup language SignalML (signal markup language) based on XML is a kind of data standard which is used to describe, pack, store and transfer signal control data for different signal controllers to facilitate to transfer and share the signal control data and control information. It describes the data format in traffic control system such as intersection geometry structure, signal control type and signal control parameter, traffic flow data etc. The paper gives out the definition of SignalML language, introduces the layer structure and builds a test platform to testify the validation of the communications standard in traffic control system. The result shows it is useful to communications of traffic control system

articleTitle: A Vertically-Moving Town-Like Mobility Model Based on a Moving Choosing Factor in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
abstract: It is known to all that how to select a proper mobility model is essential in simulating the performance of all kinds of protocols in ad hoc networks. In our real lives, each mobile node moves with a certain purpose rather than totally randomly. So the research based on the totally randomly moving mobility models seems meaningless to some extent. In this paper, we propose a novel mobility model based on a moving choosing factor, which can depict the moving regularities of the mobile nodes in most big towns and cities exactly. Furthermore, due to the added choosing factor, this mobility model is proved to be more practical and move significant for us to master and I believe it can be very useful in the traffic study

articleTitle: TCP Vegas_M: A Novel TCP Algorithm in Mobile Ad hoc Network
abstract: While it has been shown that TCP Vegas provides better performance compared to TCP Reno, studies have identified various issues associated with the protocol in mobile ad hoc networks. We propose modifications to the congestion avoidance mechanism of the TCP Vegas to overcome these limitations. Our solution, named TCP Vegas_M, is dependent on FEDM fuzzy logic theory to distinguish network congestion states and wireless channel states, and based on ad hoc networks states (congestion, uncertain, and bit error), TCP sender adopt different congestion avoidance algorithms to control congestion window size, aims is to optimize ad hoc network throughput and achieve better performance. Simulation experiments show that TCP Vegas-M is able to overcome several of the identified problems-it can obtain more throughput than TCP Reno and TCP Vegas, and avoid oscillation of TCP sender congestion window. Keywords: mobile ad hoc network, TCP Vegas, fuzzy logic theory, round trip time

articleTitle: An extended version of the differential-integral approach based on the Transverse Wave Formulation
abstract: An original differential-integral approach, based on the transverse wave formulation (TWF) is presented to study planar circuits in periodic network. The introduction of a novel impedance surface sub-domain in TWF offers a natural framework for the implementation of complex planar structures with simple layer. The different simulation results obtained by our electromagnetic software based on this method that we developed under object oriented environment C++ are in good agreement with literature

articleTitle: Optimized Minimum Spanning Tree Phase Unwrapping Algorithm for Phase Image of Interferometric SAR
abstract: At present, SAR Interferometry (InSAR) is a technique for the generation of digital elevation models from space.[1] The phase image unwrapping is the most important Step in processing the interferometric SAR data. Goldstein's branch-cut algorithm is now the most classical one of the known phase unwrapping algorithms. It connects residues with branch-cut lines to neutralize their charges so that the integral path can't stride over the branches in the process of phase unwrapping, thus avoiding pervasion of error. However, due to improper connections, this always brings about too many, too long and even closed branch-cut lines that can not be unwrapped, especially when many residues exist.

articleTitle: RoF based Microcellular Network for Vehicle Mobile Radio Communication System
abstract: After radio over fiber technology is expatiated, a RoF based microcellular networks is introduced. In this network microcells in a wide area are connected by optical fibers and radio signals transmitted over an optical fiber link among base stations and control stations and its network architecture and basic operations are discussed in the end

articleTitle: An Extensible Centre-Control Routing Protocol in MANET
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks have no support infrastructure and show a highly dynamic character. Due to its mobility, multi-hop communication, energy limitation and uncertainty of wireless communication, data transmission in network, namely routing, becomes a key problem to be solved. Most existing routing protocols based on topology information have a weak extensibility and a bad support to QoS. To solve this problem, a new centre-control routing protocol with better extensibility is proposed in our study of ad hoc networking. Simulations and related analyses show that this protocol has a good extensibility and high delivery rate of packet in large-scale ad hoc network, and presents a useful means to support QoS routing in ad hoc network

articleTitle: A Filter-based Approach for Optimizing Top-k Queries in Wireless Sensor Networks
abstract: This paper presents an efficient approach for top-k query processing in wireless sensor networks (WSN) called FaVN-K. Our approach is similar to the FILA proposed by Wu et al. in that each sensor node is assigned with a value range called filter. What is different is that in FaVN-K virtual node is introduced to solve the problem of overlapping ranges. FaVN-K can achieve exact top-k result if all the nodes follow the filtering rules strictly. The experimental results show that FaVN-K can reduce transmission volume dramatically, which is especially important to WSN

articleTitle: Research on H.323 Communications Passing Through NAT/Firewall
abstract: The applications of videoconference and IP telephone fall under the restriction of the network address translation (NAT) and firewall technique. This paper analyzed the difficulties of H.323 communications passing through NAT and firewall detailed, and studied some new solutions to those problems on Linux firewall system

articleTitle: The Design for Wireless Surroundings Measurement System within Car
abstract: It appears that it is possible for us to make a wireless communication of even home-network system within car by integrating with the ubiquitous such as mobile phone, wireless Internet, GPS and DMB in the future. If the present wireless surroundings within the car are connected with very high-speed wireless network as measurement system for wireless communication surroundings within this car in the future, it will develop the complicated communication conditions such as safe checkup, communication between systems within car, and wireless communication for user entertainment unlike universal communication conditions. Accordingly, there is the necessity of the device that can measure the interference of electric wave, communication speed and communication quality by a kind of each car. This paper aims at making the real measurement device to raise the reliability of each Application for inquiring into the interference about each other in the frequency band used under telematics surroundings

articleTitle: A peer to peer based workflow model
abstract: This research focuses on providing a workflow model that is based on peer-to-peer architecture. Distributed and parallel computing is the design concept. It will provide maximum performance and give the system the highest scalability, flexibility and configurability. This model contains a supervisor-agents working unit, a hub that is a housekeeper for all data transaction, a workbench that provides a platform for all workflow configurations. Each agent is responsible for a specific task, like converting a file from one format to another, or, getting input from end user. A supervisor can take care of multiple agents. One computer has one supervisor. Supervisors are responsible for agents' load balance, launching/killing agents, communicating with other supervisors to keep the whole system at its peak performance. If we call supervisor-agents working unit as one peer, the model consists all peers and peers are communicating each other to keep the system running. Hub stores all system data, like configuration data, task loading data, etc., and all work files, like input/output, database transactions, metafiles, etc. It also has a system wise database to keep all system logs and task balancing. Workbench stands for a platform or UI for users to configure their workflows. A workflow can contain many working steps; each step calls one agent to fulfil the real tasks. Depends on the customer needs, users can have many steps as they want to. And also they can have many workflows as necessary

articleTitle: The Optimal Loading of Robust Adaptive Beamforming Based on Worst-Case Performance Optimization
abstract: In this paper the robust adaptive beamforming (RABF) based on worst-case performance optimization is investigated. This method belongs to the class of diagonal loading approaches and determines the loading level by optimizing the worst-case performance. Other than solving the optimal loading by iteration, as many existing methods in this field did, we derive a simple closed-form solution to the optimal loading after some approximations. In addition to reducing the computational complexity, this simple analytical solution reveals how different factors affect the optimal loading. Numerical examples confirm that the closed-form expression is a very accurate approximation to the actual optimal loading

articleTitle: Decreasing FCD Processing Delay by Deploying Distributed Processing System
abstract: A field test for floating car data (FCD) based traffic information processing & provisioning system is carrying on in Beijing, with over 2,000 floating cars uploading FCD every 90 seconds. However, as a practical system targeted by the government, 20,000 or more floating cars will be deployed for FCD collecting. Ten times more amount of FCD might lead to the unacceptable processing delay. Multiple servers based distributed FCD processing system is a cost efficient way to achieve the low processing delay and high availability. This paper suggests the structure of distributed system and algorithms of optimizing the distributed system by efficiently balancing work load, which can effectively keep the processing delay within an acceptable level

articleTitle: Analysis and Realization to Security of Radio Frequency Identification system
abstract: This paper briefly presents theories and structure of RFID system .The current solutions to RFID security and privacy: such as "blocker tags" which offers a secure communication channel between RFID tags and their owner are explained, analyzed and compared. These approaches provide a very attractive alternative for addressing privacy concerns raised by the potential widespread use of RFID tags in consumer products

articleTitle: A Novel Dynamic Stepsize Power Control Algorithm for UMTS W-CDMA Systems
abstract: Power control is an essential mechanism for wideband code division multiple access (W-CDMA) systems. In our earlier work, a combined power control and a greedy rate packing (GRP) allocation scheme employing conventional fixed stepsize power control (FSPC) is discussed and evaluated. In this paper, we extend the algorithm to apply a novel dynamic stepsize power control (DSPC) algorithm to improve system performance. The dynamic stepsize (DS) is determined by the difference between the target SIR* and the received SIR. A larger stepsize is applied when the difference between the received SIR and the target SIR* is large to enhance tracking ability, and vice versa to reduce granular noise. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed DSPC algorithm, with around 2% gain of throughput, 6.5% average power consumption saving and 0.5 dB standard deviation (STD) reduction of the received SIR, when compared with the FSPC scheme

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization for Bistatic PCL Radar
abstract: In this paper the accuracy of measurement with respect to some parameters like baseline variance and DOA estimation and bistatic RCS is considered. The Radar designer can find the appropriate parameters to having the minimum error in target localization and maximum coverage range.

articleTitle: Closed-Form Capacity and Outage Probability Expressions for Orthogonal Space-Time Block Codes
abstract: Space-time block coding is a modulation scheme recently discovered for the transmit antenna diversity to combat effects in wireless fading channels. In this paper, using Meijer's G function, we give the closed-form capacity expressions of orthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBCs) over usual uncorrelated fading channel (Nakagami-m, Ricean) and correlated Rayleigh fading channel. The closed-form capacity expression of OSTBCs over Nakagami-m fading channels with keyhole is also presented. Outage probability is an important and relevant performance measure in the design of wireless communication systems to operate in a fading environment. We can derive simple closed-form outage probability expressions over the above cases. These formulas are simply expressed

articleTitle: Realization of Urban Traffic Flow's Guidance System and Simulation Based on MapX
abstract: This paper is based on characteristic of urban transportation in Wuhan compiles a soft which uses the component of MapX and secondarily develops in object-oriented software VC and realizes urban traffic flow's guidance system and simulation in Wuhan using the method of multi-path with limited traffic flow

articleTitle: Using IPSec to Secure Multi-Level Data Classification in MLS Networks
abstract: In this paper we present a method of using IPSec to secure Multi-level data classification in the MLS Networks by using the data sensitivity. We will show how IPsec can be modified to be used in securing communication in a MLS network

articleTitle: An adaptive hybrid MIMO scheme with fixed antennas
abstract: An adaptive hybrid MIMO scheme has been proposed for multi-antenna system based on the uniformed hybrid MIMO model combining the transmit diversity and spatial multiplexing. The adaptive hybrid MIMO scheme adaptively adjusts the allocation of freedom degree i.e. gain ratio between the diversity and multiplexing with the adaptive hybrid MIMO preceding according to the variation of channel condition to achieve the necessary diversity gain and spatial multiplexing gain simultaneously. Meanwhile, an adaptive hybrid detection method is designed to complete the hybrid spatial multiplexing signal separation and transmit diversity signal decoding. Simulation results show that: for the multi-antenna system with the fixed antennas, compared with other transmit diversity and spatial multiplexing schemes, the proposed adaptive hybrid MIMO scheme can achieve the best performance and highest capacity during the whole channel SNR variation span

articleTitle: The performance of Single Observer Passive Location using Bearings-Only with the Modified UKF
abstract: The bearings-only (BO) method of passive location is modeled and its algorithm and error analyses are shown in this paper, then, the paper introduces the recently developed unscented Kalman filter (UKF). What is more, the modified UKF in application to BO is compared to the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF). Results using this new algorithm indicate that the improved UKF provides more accurate estimates and easier implementation than EKF which make it more feasible to use. Meanwhile because of the limitation of bearings-only, even if use the UKF to BO, the location effect is also deteriorated when the azimuth angle becomes enlarged

articleTitle: A Digital Correcting Algorithm of Quadrature Double Channels Unbalance
abstract: The whole system distortion is inevitable in I and Q channels of analog circuit because of the existing of amplitude and phase unbalance, the performance of receiving system become worse. Begins with the mathematical deduction, the paper presents an I and Q channels digital correcting algorithm, which is applicable to any kinds of symmetrical windows. This method implements simply and has high correcting accuracy. Finally, simulation results verify the validity of the method

articleTitle: Study of Vehicle Autonomous Navigation and Guidance with Self-study Type GPS receiver
abstract: Autonomous navigation of vehicle running with GPS receiver is an important study aspect of future vehicle navigation field. This paper introduces a self-study type navigation method. In this method, real-time receiving for position information of vehicle running track is carried out by embedded GPS receiver, and linearized processing with unitary regression algorithm for discrete position information received by GPS receiver is carried out by microprocessor, then linear correlation of track information is judged by linear correlation coefficient and track information is divided into sections based on degree of linear correlation. Position information of running track is obtained by self-study and the formed autonomous navigation track information is of high navigation accuracy and predictability of front direction. This method needs no professional GIS technology to support and is of excellent flexibility

articleTitle: A Fast Block-Matching Motion Estimation Algorithm For H.264/AVC
abstract: The H.264 video coding standard has achieved a significant improvement in coding efficiency compared to previous standards, such as MPEG1/2/4 and H.261/H.263, whereas its complexity is significantly increased at the same time. In an H.264 encoder, the most time consuming component is variable block size motion estimation. In order to reduce the complexity of motion estimation, a fast block matching motion estimation algorithm is proposed in this paper, which is based on the diamond search (DS) algorithm. This algorithm well exploits the correlation between video sequence motion activity and macro-block coding pattern and motion vector statistic characteristics, judged by rate-distortion optimization rule, so it significantly reduces the search complexity of motion estimation. Experimental results show that the algorithm provides faster search speed than FS and DS algorithm while it provides the almost the same value in PSNR

articleTitle: A Model for Radio Access Unit Selection in Distributed Radio System
abstract: In this paper, we present an analytic model for radio access unit selection in distributed radio system. The selection strategy is based on received signal strength measurements and described as a multiple state Markov chain. Performance analysis results show that numeric data achieved from the model are in good agreement with simulation results, which verifies the validity of the model. This model is helpful in designing seamless handoff schemes in distributed radio system

articleTitle: Dual Mode AVMA for Blind Equalization and Carrier Phase Recovery in Distorted Communication Channels
abstract: A modified version of adaptively varying modulus algorithm (AVMA) is presented: the dual mode adaptively varying modulus algorithm (DM/AVMA), which accomplishes blind equalization and carrier phase recovery simultaneously in case of distorted channels. The DM/AVMA first acts a standard MCMA and once the convergence to certain level is achieved, the AVMA comes into action to acquire the signal constellation toward the orientation of the source constellation. The whole operation is controlled by adjusting the coefficients of two gradient vectors for each cost function correspondingly. Simulations studies for the case of 16-QAM signal constellation confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in clustering the equalized signals, recovering and correcting the carrier phase shift and removing ISI in the presence of distorted communication channels

articleTitle: An Efficient Adaptive Beamforming Techniquewith Pattern Control Ability
abstract: In this paper, we propose an iterative algorithm, which can achieve beampattern control and adaptive beamforming at the same time. Our proposed algorithm is computationally efficient because it avoids the calculation of matrix inverse which is often required by conventional beampattern synthesis algorithms. Besides this advantage, the new algorithm is superior in being able to shape the sidelobe region which is left uncontrolled by other adaptive beamforming algorithms. Numerical results show that our proposed algorithm has the ability of nulling out interferences and maintaining a well-shaped beampattern simultaneously

articleTitle: Design of a Onboard Dual Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna
abstract: An onboard dual-frequency antenna based on the concept of the reconfigurable is proposed. It is a planar microstrip slot antenna with coplanar waveguide feed-in network, which works at two different frequency ranges of the third generation mobile communication. The model of the antenna and the radiation patterns are present. According to the result of simulation, the antenna can indeed work at two different frequency ranges while its radiate pattern almost keeps no changes, and it is a frequency reconfigurable antenna

articleTitle: Design of Multifunctional Base Station for AVIM System
abstract: Automatic Vehicle Identification Management System (AVM), consisting of RFID technology, control technology, communication technology and network technology, gets more and more attentions in the international and domestic. The successful design of Multifunctional Base Station laid the cornerstone for the industrialization construction of the AVIM System in China. A series of AVIM functional base stations can be derived from the Multifunctional Base Station. This paper introduces the Multifunctional Base Station designed and will be used in Hunan AVIM project.

Author Keywords: AVIM Base Station, electronic license plate

articleTitle: An UWB Super-Resolution Method of Motive Target
abstract: The high frequency UWB radar echo of a static target can be modeled as ARMA and approached by state-space technique. But this method is only valid when the target is static. Further, the motive target model of UWB radar is presented. This model is composed of a static model and a polynomial phase caused by the motion of target, and based this character a cyclostationary method can be used to estimate the motion parameters of the target. After the motive target model compensated by the estimated parameters, the eigenvalues can be extracted by the first method. The result of simulations shows the proposed method can correctly obtain the super-resolution of the motive target

articleTitle: Capacity Analysis of Multi-user Diversity in Generalized Distributed Cellular Architecture
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of utilizing multi-user diversity (MUD) strategy in generalized distributed cellular architecture-group cell. The group cell architecture can take full advantage of multi-antenna technologies and solve the problem of frequent handover caused by increase of carrier frequency. The system capacity of group cell is analyzed and the capacity gain brought by MUD in group cell is emphasized in this paper. The theoretical analyses are provided to give the capacity gain bought by MUD and the bottom bound of capacity gain is deduced. Simulation results are also presented to verify the theoretical analyses

articleTitle: An Efficient Method for Common Channel Interference Mitigation in WCDMA Downlink
abstract: Wide-band code division multiple access (WCDMA), as one of the most important third-generation mobile communication standards, is being supported by most of the telecom operators around the world. On the pace of the network construction and commercial operation of WCDMA system, the cell capacity is playing more and more important rules. Among different kinds of efforts, channel interference mitigation is a very efficient way to enlarge this parameter. In this paper, an efficient method for common channel interference mitigation in downlink of WCDMA system is presented. The complexity of this technique is very low and simulation results show its superior performance to the conventional RAKE receiver and the CPICH interference mitigation receiver proposed in 3GPP technical specification

articleTitle: Access Control of Data in Integrated Voice/Video/Data Wireless CDMA Systems
abstract: An access control scheme is developed for voice/video/data integrated wireless code division multiple access (CDMA) systems. The scheme involves predicting the residual capacity available for non real-time data traffic based on Gaussian approximation. Besides, a new performance measure called outage bandwidth efficiency is defined to describe the percentage of bandwidth which can be effectively utilized. Simulation results indicate that, compared with the existing access control scheme, significant improvement in overall system performance, including outage probability and outage bandwidth efficiency, can be achieved with the proposed access control scheme

articleTitle: Multiuser Adaptive Radio Resource Allocation Based on OFDM Networks
abstract: It is a challenging problem to efficiently allocate limited and varying network resources in the wireless communication networks to a variety of multiple services with different characteristics and requirements. Assuming knowing the instantaneous channel conditions of all users, we propose a reduced complexity adaptive radio resource allocation algorithm to maximize the frequency efficiency, while guaranteeing the quality of service (QoS) of different users. It is done by assigning the best subcarriers to the corresponding users and by modulating the subcarriers with better channel gains to a higher order. Our proposed algorithm is easy to implement because of the great reduction in complexity. The results show that it can achieve the near optimal solution

articleTitle: Research on Application of Association Rule Algorithm in Intelligence Transportation System
abstract: To support the decision-making of traffic control effectively, an association rules algorithm based on data cube was proposed in the paper. First, data cube from database was set up. Then frequent item-set which satisfied the minimum support on data cube was mined out. Furthermore, association rules of frequent item-set were obtained. Finally, redundant association rules were wiped off through the relative method. The algorithm had two advantages, the first was that the executing time of the algorithm was short while searching for the frequent item-set; the second was that the rules' interest degree was high. The algorithm was also used intelligence traffic system and a few effective patterns were obtained. The results manifested that the algorithm was effective in decision-making support of traffic control

articleTitle: Implementation of DSRC System with Wireless Link Between RSE and Local Server
abstract: Telematics can provide various multimedia services in wireless access systems. One method of wireless access in telematics is DSRC (dedicated short range communication) which supports a wireless channel between RSE (road side equipment) and QBE (on board equipment). In this DSRC system, a wire path such as ADSL (asymmetric digital subscriber line) connects the RSE to a local server. However, the wire itself presents some technical problems, such as high installation costs, difficulty of maintenance and repair, and so on. We propose replacing the wire path with a wireless link between the RSE and local server, and test the performance through experiments

articleTitle: Linear-Complex LAS Detectors Can Achieve Bit Error Rate of the NP-Hard Optimum Detector in Non-trivial Large Random Spreading CDMA
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate via simulation that the linear-complex LAS detectors can amazingly achieve the bit error rate of the NP-hard optimum global maximum likelihood (GML) multiuser detector in large random spreading CDMA systems where the number of users is over a thousand and the number of users per degree is less than 0.9. Moreover, the LAS detectors suggestively attain the optimum asymptotic multiuser efficiency, which only the NP-hard GML detector has been known to attain.

articleTitle: A Discrete Distributed Topology-control Algorithm of Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: The problem of topology configuration and its control of a wireless sensor network (WSN) are dealt with in this paper. Topology algorithm of a wireless sensor network aims to minimize the energy consumption and increase the lifecycle of the WSN. A localized discrete distributed topology-control algorithm (DDTCA) of WSN is presented. The DDTCA strongly decreases the redundancy links of WSN. Firstly, the topology links of WSN is discreted and formed a number of isolated network island topologies. These network island topologies have the bounded degree and the best link qualities for each node. Then, all isolated network islands are linked by intersubgraph algorithm which minimizes the power energy consumption between the isolated network islands. Simulation results show advantages of the algorithm

articleTitle: A UWB Ranging Algorithm Based on Almost Perfect Autocorrelation Sequences
abstract: Since the bandwidth of UWB (ultra-wideband) is very large, UWB systems have excellent accuracy in terms of distance measurement which is important for the intelligent transport system (ITS). A UWB ranging algorithm based on almost perfect autocorrelation (APA) sequences is proposed. The computer simulation results show that the UWB ranging system based on APA sequences achieves higher accuracy in comparison with the conventional sequences system under the same condition, and increasing the length of the APA sequences can lead to millimeter precision

articleTitle: Real-Time data and confidence declaration algorithm for MSSR Reply
abstract: This paper presents a kind of method which can extract reply of mono-pulse secondary surveillance radar (MSSR) effectively at high density reply and introduce the real-time algorithm of confidence analyzing on the reply code. This arithmetic can not only extract code and confidence of the pulse reply code a time, but also fulfil the OVERLAP and de-FTUTI processing. The reply differentiation and confidence estimation can be correctly confirmed when there is multi-target reply-blend, providing available report form of the target trace

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cooperative Diversity Protocols for Multihop Wireless Networks
abstract: This paper investigates two-phase cooperative diversity protocols for multihop wireless networks over generalized fading environments. We analyze their regenerative outage probability in term of symmetrical and asymmetrical network configurations. Their generalized diversity order expressions are derived at high average signal-to-noise ratio (ASNR). The theoretical and simulation results show that the cooperative systems can offer the full diversity order at some given manners. However, the generalized diversity order is determined by the sum of the two cooperative route diversities, not the total number of the cooperative nodes, where the smaller diversity order in two-hop route plays an important role

articleTitle: Research on Coexistence Characteristics of DS-UWB Systems
abstract: The power of ultra-wideband (UWB) systems has an extremely large frequency bandwidth which is a potential interference to some narrowband systems such as GPS, CDMA and WLAN. So it's a key problem to explore the coexistence characteristics of UWB systems to some narrowband system since UWB techniques are being put in practice in high rate data communication and high precision radio navigation & location applications. It's presented the analysis of three factors, power spectral density (PSD) of modulated sequence, pulse repetition frequency (PRF) and energy spectral density (ESD) of pulse, which may have effect on interference power to other systems. It's proposed that pseudo-random codes with suitable properties or parameters and pulse with well designed waveform could reduce the interference in some extent. It's presented the simulation of interference power of DS-UWB system with typical narrowband system, such as GPS (L1). Furthermore, GPS (L1) suffering from single and multi-interference of DS-UWB is analyzed in detail. Safe distance is computed by direct and simulation method respectively when single DS-UWB interference exists. Safe density is computed by plane area integral and Monte Carlo simulation when multi-interference exists

articleTitle: Analysis of the Double-conversion Scheme Based on Single Local Oscillator
abstract: For strict requirement, the local oscillator is always a difficult problem when designing the communication system based on the double-conversion scheme. In this paper, a kind of improved double-conversion scheme is introduced in which single local oscillator is needed, and key issues about this double-conversion scheme with single local oscillator are also discussed. The scheme is possessed of the advantages of traditional double-conversion system, but simultaneously decreases the difficulty when realizing the local oscillator. So, it is favorable in system miniaturization and integration. Based on careful analysis of the new scheme and an engineering example, some formula and designing rule of system parameters, such as bandwidth and center frequency of intermediate frequency filter, are proposed. The method discussed in this paper is also applicable in other frequency band

articleTitle: The Research and Application Analysis for the New Generation Parking Information Service System in China
abstract: The parking industry is a new "sunrise industry" coming with the upraising of civil mobilization level. In this paper, starting from two aspects, market operation for WPS and technical application of ATIS in PIS field, we introduce the current technical status of PIS and standardization tasks in China, discuss the concepts and contents of NGPIS, and suggest the structure and technical schema for WPS-based PISS (wireless payment system-based parking information service system). Finally, we analyze and summarize the application prospect and market development

articleTitle: Simulation and Comparison of Two Classes of High Gain Lens Antennas in Transportation System
abstract: Two classes of lens antennas in transportation system are described in which offer unique advantages by their own structure characters. To realize wide band and high gain operations for the transportation system, some antennas are designed and compared in this paper. By optimization, the two classes of antennas can both realize the same radial character and the bandwidth is enough for practical operation. The simulation results and analyses of the Luneburg lens and the optimum two-shell dielectric sphere lens antenna are presented.

articleTitle: Design of a Double-Sided and Printed Wideband Dipole Array Antenna on 5.2GHz Band
abstract: The use of printed and doubled-sided dipole array wideband antenna in application of 5.2 GHz UNII band operated in WLAN access point has been demonstrated in this paper. The printed dipole array antenna consists of one dipole array arranged back to back and can be easily framed by printing on both sides of a dielectric substrate and is suitable for integration with monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) module. Based on the matching theory, which includes of a 50 Omega microstrip feed line with quarter-wavelength transformer matched circuits is designed. Properties of the radiator as an array element have also been investigated. Simulator IE3D is used to verify our analysis. Both simulation and measured data are pretty matched. According to the measured results, the measured gain for 5.2 GHz band is between 3.8 and 5 dBi and the bandwidth with VSWR less than 2 is about 400 MHz

articleTitle: Research on Trace Tracking and Identification Technology Based on Magnetic Induction Intensity
abstract: In application fields of self-direction of vehicle, unmanned drive, trace robot and trace finder, tracking and identification of trace signal have key effects on tracking reliability and accuracy. Trace characterized with magnetic induction intensity is actually electromagnetic field signal produced around conductor when current flows inside conductor, and magnetic intensity has direct relationship with distance from conductor. Trace detecting device on vehicle can detect magnetic induction intensity and its change trend, and then degree and speed of deviation from trace can be calculated by linear regression algorithm, thus, trace tracking and identification can be achieved. Trace characterized with magnetic information can adapt to many complex working environments, and intensity control of trace signal and fault diagnosis can be easily realized

articleTitle: Study on a Generic Service Description Model
abstract: Attractive services will be the crucial factor in the future competition of communication service providers. While system heterogeneity and service convergence complicate the service provisioning process, there are still no common models to support early service analysis. This paper proposes an implementation and network platform independent model for service description. It consists of four elements: EP (endpoint), LI (communication link), ELR (relations between endpoints and communication links) and LR (relations between communication links). We analyze the attributes of EP and LI which are static parts of a service and present ELR and LR by directed graphs which describe all possible behavior of the service. This model contains most basic properties used for requirements analysis and service architecture design, can support arbitrary number of users and one user can communicate with others in an arbitrary way. In the end, a multimedia conference service is described to verify the practicability of this model

articleTitle: System of Freeway Network Management for All-circumstance Safety Operation
abstract: In order to meet the demands of the development of freeway network, associating with the analysis of structure and function of the existing freeway management, the frame of freeway network management system is elementarily established based on state-of-the freeway network management abroad for all-circumstance operation. The system includes categories of freeway network information, analysis of influencing factors, safety management countermeasures and decision-making.

articleTitle: A Delay Constraint Optimal Path Algorithm for Ad Hoc MPLS Networks
abstract: Multiple constraints optimal path (MCOP) problem is a key problem of ad hoc MPLS networks. For the restricted computing and memory capability of ad hoc networks node equipments, the MCOP problem of ad hoc MPLS networks is more difficult than the current networks. In this paper, a novel ad hoc networks delay constraint optimal path (ADCOP) algorithm is proposed. By reduced the search region of the algorithm, the efficiency of algorithm can be improved effectively and an optimal loop-less path can be gotten. The self-adapting parameter design is adopted in this algorithm to improve the adaptability on the network scale. Using extensive simulations on random graphs and random assigned link weights, the huge improvement in complexity of the new algorithm is tested. The test also indicates that the algorithm has more adaptability and more practicability

articleTitle: Response Analysis of High Frequency Electromagnetic Wave Well Logging
abstract: High frequency electromagnetic wave well logging can eliminate the influence of water salinity in the stratum remarkably. Further more, it can provide an accurate explanation in the water flood layers with low conductivity, according to measuring dielectric constant. Its response will be analyzed in this paper

Author Keywords: high frequency electromagnetic wave well logging

articleTitle: Bringing multi-tunneling management to Ubique framework
abstract: The Internet takes day after day more place in our lives. It is from now on, "the", medium we use, to exchange at work, at home or in a cybercafe. But that is not enough anymore. The explosion of telecommunication technology wired and wireless (cellular, radio, satellite), with IPv6, mobility emergence and the availability of multi-interfaces mobile routers, takes us along to what is called the ubiquitous Internet. The Internet anytime, everywhere and...for everybody. In this context, these multihomed equipments are now able to access the Internet via each of theirs interfaces through one or more Internet service provider. Multihoming brings new possibilities in routing process and traffic management. The advantages of this features has been explained. But there are still many questions. How to manage this new features? How to select the most accurate interface in a context aware manner? The ubique framework has been developed for multi-interfaces mobile station and later adapted to the mobile router. Yet, we still have to add to the ubique architecture the ability to support multiple care-of address just as different interfaces. This multi-tunneling support is evaluated using static policy routing in NEPL (NEmo Platform for Linux) environment

articleTitle: Soft Information Combining for Turbo-MIMO Retransmission
abstract: We studied three types of retransmission scheme for turbo-MIMO packet: Chase combining, soft information combining and incremental redundancy, which are suitable for different situations. The channel in each retransmission is correlated in temporal dimension, the simulation result shows using different interleavers in retransmission is very effective in correlated channel. We also find coding gain of incremental redundancy over Chase combining under most circumstances

articleTitle: An Adaptive Fuzzy Filter Based on Two Different Sets for Nonlinear Channel Estimation
abstract: The opportune estimation of channel gain in wireless communication is significant to successful power control, but the channel's nonlinear characteristic degrades the performance of conventional estimation method. Based on fuzzy filter theory, a novel adaptive fuzzy least mean square (LMS) filter for channel estimation is proposed. Utilizing the human experiences and statistical knowledge of signal's fading, the filter builds two different type of fuzzy sets over the space of channel gain, which reflect the channel gain's value and its moving trends respectively, then adjusts the parameters of the member functions of the sets with LMS algorithm, thus adapts itself to the nonlinear characteristics of communication channel. The result of simulation experiment validates the efficiency of the algorithm

articleTitle: Spatial Precoding and Loading for Multi-User Mutiple-Antenna OFDM Systems
abstract: In this paper we investigated interference pre-subtraction problems in multi-users downlink channel for multiple-antennas OFDM system, in which the number of users is larger than the number of transmit antennas. We present a new jointly spatial loading and preceding strategy to select reasonably a group of users for each tone on each transmit antenna by maximizing signal to interference and noise ratio (SINR), Then we introduce vector perturbation preceding in order to cancel multi-users interference at transmitter and achieve the maximum capacity or the minimum BER. Compared with conventional channel inversion and regularization channel inversion method, our proposed method has demonstrated a better performance than other methods because of multi-users diversity gain. Moreover, the proposed method would not increase peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of systems

articleTitle: Palmyre : a MIMO reconfigurable transmission platform for ITS applications
abstract: Intelligent Transportation System telecommunications require the development of reconfigurable demonstration platforms. The PALMYRE platform is a federative project with the aim of coordinating and developing research activities and application programs in the fields of radio communications and MIMO systems within public and private laboratories in Brittany, France. This project involves the design and implementation of a platform for radio system development and evaluation. This platform allows a modular design of systems with reconfigurable, interchangeable and reprogrammable software and hardware components. The objective is to develop and to test radio communication techniques and electronic systems in realistic conditions. A robust serial transmission system, involving digital and radiofrequency parts, has been developed to be used as a test reference for the platform. In this paper, the MIMO 4X4 compliant radiofrequency circuit and its implementation are described. Lastly, simulation results and validation measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Digital 2D imaging techniques for SRR
abstract: For safety relevant applications various types of sensors are currently brought onto the market. Short Range Radar (SRR) sensors offer new perspectives delivering information about the traffic scenario around the vehicle. Currently different sensor concepts for 2D imaging are being discussed. The application of coherent phase analysis for angular procesing seems to be a very powerful approach. In this paper the applicability of two suchlike techniques - Digital Beam-Forming and Music2D - for SRR systems is investigated. These instructions give you basic guidelines for preparing papers for conference proceedings.

articleTitle: A Novel Antenna Selection Algorithm for MIMO Systems under Correlated Channels
abstract: In this work, a new antenna selection algorithm is proposed for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) wireless communication systems. It is assumed that the channel state information (CSI) is exactly known at the receiver, and hence the antenna selection is considered only at the receiver. The goal of antenna selection is to find a tradeoff between the maximization of the channel capacity and the minimization of the pair-wise error probability (PEP). It turns out that the scheme of antenna selection plays an important part when dealing with high antenna correlation. It is shown that our proposed scheme for a system with two-transmit antennas and five-receive antennas offers better PEP performance than the algorithm based on the maximization capacity, but has little capacity loss. The simulation results indicate that our proposed scheme can jointly meet the capacity maximization and the PEP minimization

articleTitle: Iterative Decoding for the Concatenation of LDPC Codes and BCH Codes Based on Chase Algorithm
abstract: In this paper, an iterative joint decoding algorithm for low density parity check codes with BCH codes based on Chase algorithm is proposed. After a certain number of iterations, the soft output values delivered by belief propagation algorithm of LDPC codes are used as reliability values to perform Chase decoding of BCH codes. And BCH decoder also will return soft information to LDPC decoder as input. This approach presents an option scheme for LDPC with medium length because of the relevant presence of short loops. It allows to bridge the gap between error performance and maximum likelihood decoding. Simulation result for the scheme is given.

articleTitle: TCP-CDR: An End-to-End Scheme for TCP Over Mobile Ad hoc Networks
abstract: In this paper, we present an end-to-end scheme, named as TCP-CDR, for the performance improvement of TCP over mobile ad hoc networks. This scheme combines congestion window limit, delayed ACK and maximum RTO limit. The comparisons between TCP-CDR and state-of-the-art end-to-end TCP schemes, including Newreno, FeW, TCP-AP, TCP-CD (CWL and Delayed ACK), show that both in static multihops wireless network and in mobile ad hoc networks, the TCP-CDR has the best goodput performance. In particular, different with the previous works, we generate the mobile scenarios not only using Random Waypoint mobility model but also social network mobility model

articleTitle: Research on A Carrier Synchronization Method for Digital Radio Compass
abstract: Radio compass called automatic direction finder (ADF) is a basic navigation equipment. The traditional radio compasses were implemented with analog circuit, which suffered low precision. The development of software radio technology and DSP technology has made the software radio compass (SRC) possible. The existed SRC needs to convert three input signals to a fixed frequency at the same time and it's hard to synchronize. In this paper, a new method to implement the carrier synchronization is presented and simulated. The simulation results shown the proposed approach can meet the specified radio compass performance.

articleTitle: Application of Modern Sensor- and Info-Technology in Long-Term Safety Monitoring of Long Span Rigid-Frame Bridge
abstract: The issue of safety has been concerned throughout the world. This paper, taking a long span continuous rigid-frame bridge as an example, introduces the application of the modern sensor- and info-technology in the said bridge by presenting the components of the monitoring system, the acquisition and transmission of the monitored data, and the bridge safety evaluation system. The experiment has proved that the application of the sensor- and info-technology into civil engineering projects can bring about good social, economical and scientific effects

articleTitle: Performance of Wireless Mesh Networks with Centralized Multihop Scheduling for Intelligent Transportation Systems
abstract: We consider the problem of centralized multihop scheduling in wireless mesh networks for solutions to realize intelligent transportation systems. A scheduling tree construction strategy is investigated, which could use any predetermined selection metrics, while avoiding primary and secondary interferences to a great extent. Two centralized multihop scheduling algorithms are presented to schedule nodes on the constructed scheduling tree. In contrast with FIFO algorithm, the fair algorithm has the property that it guarantees fairness among downlink relay queues of each relay node, while making an efficient utilization of free mini-slots. The feasibility of scheduling tree construction strategy with both minimal hop count and maximal signal strength metrics for a mesh cell is studied through experiment. Simulation results of network throughput and average active link number show that the Fair algorithm utilizes network resources more efficiently than the FIFO algorithm

articleTitle: Hybrid DCF Supporting Smart Antennas in WLANs
abstract: Hybrid distributed coordination function (H-DCF), a modified MAC protocol of IEEE 802.11, is proposed in this paper to support hybrid antennas, i.e., smart adaptive array antennas and omni-directional antennas in one WLAN.
